_meta.doc27: D14 (scoring: the reading score), §5 (score for reading)
_meta.author: design thread, 1 Oct 2026 (designed, not sourced)
_meta.DO_NOT_EXPOSE: Hidden content: the ideal stance per quarter reveals the scenario. Read only by the act3End reveal (the chapter report) and tests/tools oracles; never by selectors, the UI during play, or player-like bots.
_meta.stance: +1 = offensive (build, borrow, buy, lock long), -1 = defensive (sell, repay, raise cash, shorten, stay flexible), 0 = no clear move needed
_meta.formula: score_q: stance == ideal != 0 -> 1.0; stance == 0 and ideal == 0 -> 0.7, or 1.0 inside the decoy window (you held your nerve); exactly one of them is 0 -> 0.5; opposite signs -> 0. Quarters with weight 0 don't count. reading = round(100 * sum(w_q * score_q) / sum(w_q)) - decoy_penalty, clamped to 0..100.
_meta.check_values: Before decoy penalties: a player with no big move scores s0 78, s1 50, s2 50, s3 50; a perfect reader s1-s3 100 (s0's best is 78: Muddle Through has no big call, so holding your nerve through the false alarm is the whole test); doing the opposite every quarter scores s1 0.

s0.why: Muddle Through: one price reset, nothing dramatic. Staying calm is the right read; over-reacting either way is not rewarded. Its best reading score is about 79.

decoy.why: Spreads blink as if a bust is coming; fire-selling or hoarding cash here is the over-reaction.

s1.why: Great Repricing (trigger 2028Q1): get defensive from the first signals through the trigger, then buy distressed assets for about a year and a half.

decoy.why: Lead times stretch as if demand is surging (a supply problem); building or borrowing into it is the trap.

s2.why: Lift-Off (trigger 2028Q3): build, buy and lock long from the first signals through a year after the trigger.

decoy.why: Efficiency jumps as if demand will collapse; selling sites or shortening contracts here throws away the boom.

s3.why: Efficiency Shock (trigger 2027Q4): stay flexible and shorten from the start through two quarters after the trigger, then lean back in for the rebound.
s3.neutral_kinds_note: Design thread, 2 Oct 2026 (M18.9): S3's term-shortening card choices carry an immediate rent cut and the trough lasts five quarters, so in the game locked leases beat shortened ones; they count 0 here. Defensive in S3 still means repaying, selling, hedging, holding cash and not building.

decoy.why: Grid margins tighten as if power is the bottleneck; locking long or buying capacity here is the trap.

career_title_note: The career title stays Act II's valuation bands applied to the 2030Q4 valuation (doc 27 D14: 'title bands like Act II'). The reading title uses text_act3.en.json › title_bands on the reading score.
